main_body: Steampunk lamp post: a domed steel cap with a glowing lantern cage, a thin pole with a collar, and a domed base.
top_band: At x=8, light grey rows 1-4 (L=148) over a mid grey (L=122) that is only about 26 L darker. At x=11 rows 1-7 are all one tone (L=122), so there is no distinct top band. At x=4, rows 1-3 (L=158) form a thin highlight on a dome.
evidence: The caps read as banded domes shaded in tone steps, not as clear lighter ellipse top faces. Only the middle column has a barely separated 4-row highlight. At x=11 the cap is one flat tone from row 1 to row 7. The lantern windows are painted flat on the face, with no inset. The pole is a thin 2px line with no top surface. The base cap has only a 3-row highlight and then grades into the front. Overall this is a front-elevation silhouette with a shaded dome rather than a convincing 3/4 top face. When in doubt, fail.

style.evidence: The grey ramp has about 6 steps and the gold lantern glow adds warmth. But the candidate has only 13 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Its median of 13 colours per tile is below the references' 17 and 20. Outline pixels are 45% neutral, so the outline reads as a mix of black and tinted tones. The dome surfaces are smooth stepped bands with no rivet, grain or per-plate highlight texture, and the pole is a thin flat strip. Next to the roofed well and the stall it looks thinner and more sticker-like.
